description: This file defines the ClaimRequestActionAPI class, which handles API endpoints related to performing actions (such as submit, approve, reject) on claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for updating claim requests' state, validation rules, and internal logic for state transitions.

classes.name: ClaimRequestActionAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for performing actions on claim requests, including submitting, approving, paying, canceling, and rejecting claims. Implements transaction management, validation, and state transition logic.
